Ski jumping: World Cup competition in Wisła
programme.desc: The Adam Małysz ski jumping hill in Wisła is the third stop of this year's World Cup. After unpleasant views at the beginning of the season in Lillehammer, where only a handful of (mainly Polish) fans appeared in the stands, here we can count on the fans' loud support. The main actors should be the Austrians, who performed fantastically at the inauguration. Both the old guard and the young wolves showed phenomenal form. Last year's Crystal Ball winner, Stefan Kraft, was just off the podium twice in Lillehammer. The lowest step on the first day was taken by Maximilian Ortner... who was called up for this competition on an emergency basis and it was only his third appearance in the World Cup competition. If we add the excellent performances of Jan Hoerl and Daniel Tschofenig, we have clear favorites in the Nations Cup competition

programme.desc: «Plus+ Report. Maestro Obradovic» Nine-time European champion with five different teams. His passion, intensity and vehemence have marked European basketball for more than thirty years. Zeljko Obradovic was a world champion as a player with a legendary Yugoslav team before making an early move to the bench. It was in 1991, with Partizan Belgrade, the team of his life. His first season he was already European champion. Joventut, Real Madrid, Treviso, Panathinaikos and Fenerbahçe later saw him triumph. Along the way he has marked the lives and careers of hundreds of players. Many call him teacher. Obradovic returned home, to Partizan, where they adore him. And he closed the circle with his resignation in November 2025. In any case, he remains one of the main references of European basketball of all time

programme.title: 30 for 30: The Great Heisman Race of 1997
programme.desc: 30 for 30 (Sports). As part of its 30th anniversary celebration, ESPN looks back at notable sports happenings that occurred from 1979 to 2009 with this documentary series featuring 30 films from some of Hollywood's finest directors and producers. Peter Berg, Barry Levinson, John Singleton, Spike Jonze, Dan Klores, Barbara Kopple, Ron Shelton and Albert Maysles are among the filmmakers involved, and the stories told include the shocking trade of Wayne Gretzky in 1988, the Baltimore Colts' nighttime move in 1984, Reggie Miller's rivalry with the New York Knicks, the death of Len Bias in 1986, a profile of George Steinbrenner and his family business, and a look at Michael Jordan's attempt at a baseball career. A new series of 30 films premiered in October 2012 with «Broke,» about the challenges athletes face in managing their money

programme.title: Megafactories. Heineken
programme.desc: This film is an inside look at Europe's largest brewery in Zoeterwoude in Holland, covering an area of ​​almost a million square meters. Here the international company produces more than half of its annual beer volume, which in 2009 amounted to almost 11 million hectoliters. Of this amount, 80% is exported to the USA, the rest remains in Holland. Zoeterwoude also becomes the greenest megabrewery in the world, with a biogas power plant and its own transport hub handling almost 100,000 freight movements per year. We'll meet the brewing experts and brewing enthusiasts who make Heineken beer using a more than 150-year-old recipe and deliver it fresh to consumers every day. Dir.: Dylan Weiss, Pete Woods, Emre Izat. Led by: Tony Hirst, Andre Sogliuzzo, Chris Cook, David Vickery. USA, 2009, educational

programme.title: HISTORY'S GREATEST MYSTERIES S4 EP11

programme.title: HOLY MARVELS WITH DENNIS QUAID S1 EP08

programme.title: DARK MARVELS EP03
